<script setup lang="ts">
import { AutocompleteRoot, type AutocompleteRootEmits, type AutocompleteRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<AutocompleteRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<AutocompleteRootEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompleteRoot
    data-slot="autocomplete"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <slot />
  </AutocompleteRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AutocompleteAnchor, type AutocompleteAnchorProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<AutocompleteAnchorProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompleteAnchor
    data-slot="autocomplete-anchor"
    class="sigma-ui-autocomplete-anchor"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </AutocompleteAnchor>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-autocomplete-anchor {
  width: 16rem;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AutocompleteEmpty, type AutocompleteEmptyProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<AutocompleteEmptyProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompleteEmpty
    data-slot="autocomplete-empty"
    class="sigma-ui-autocomplete-empty"
    v-bind="{ ...props, ...$attrs }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </AutocompleteEmpty>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-autocomplete-empty {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  padding-block: 1.5rem;
  text-align: center;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AutocompleteInput, type AutocompleteInputEmits, type AutocompleteInputProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<AutocompleteInputProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<AutocompleteInputEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompleteInput
    data-slot="autocomplete-input"
    class="sigma-ui-autocomplete-input"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </AutocompleteInput>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-autocomplete-input {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  height: 2.25rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--input);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: transparent;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  padding-block: 0.25rem;
  padding-inline: 0.75rem;
}

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-input:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AutocompleteItem, type AutocompleteItemEmits, type AutocompleteItemProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<AutocompleteItemProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<AutocompleteItemEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompleteItem
    data-slot="autocomplete-item"
    class="sigma-ui-autocomplete-item"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </AutocompleteItem>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-autocomplete-item {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  outline: none;
  user-select: none;
}

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-item[data-highlighted] {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-item[data-disabled] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AutocompleteContentEmits, AutocompleteContentProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { AutocompleteContent, AutocompletePortal, AutocompleteViewport, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<AutocompleteContentProps>(), {
  position: 'popper',
  align: 'center',
  sideOffset: 4,
});
const emits = defineEmits<AutocompleteContentEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompletePortal>
    <AutocompleteContent
      data-slot="autocomplete-list"
      class="sigma-ui-autocomplete-list"
      v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
      :class="[$attrs.class]"
    >
      <AutocompleteViewport>
        <slot />
      </AutocompleteViewport>
    </AutocompleteContent>
  </AutocompletePortal>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-autocomplete-list {
  z-index: 50;
  width: 16rem;
  padding: 0.25rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--popover);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  color: var(--popover-foreground);
  outline: none;
}

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-list[data-state="open"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-autocomplete-in 150ms ease-out;
}

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-list[data-state="closed"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-autocomplete-out 150ms ease-in;
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-autocomplete-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-autocomplete-out {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
</style>
